candidate_rank.summary: Best overall target-identity and topology preservation across the 20 hard-subject runoff. It is the default model for this repository concept.
Close second with strong visual asset quality. Keep configurable as the alternate when style is prioritized.
Often visually attractive, but less reliable on difficult morphology and target-identity preservation than the selected pair.

scoring_principle: Prefer target identity, topology, small-part anatomy, and contact with the bonsai branch or pot over merely attractive images.

scope.claim: Evidence-based model selection for this repository's current fixed-theme asset-generation concept.
scope.non_claim: This is not a general model-quality benchmark and does not claim universal superiority.

artifact_policy.reason: Generated images remain temporary CI artifacts; the repository stores selection evidence and configuration only.
